purpose: Preserve, verbatim and with provenance, two audit-of-record artifacts that were AUTHORED IN THE PRODUCER WORKSPACE of run 38982176936 and then removed from the producer deliverable, because (a) a producer cannot produce its own audit of record and (b) their presence outside the producer write scope is the confirmed cause of that run's chain failure.

immutable_git_provenance.why_that_commit: the workflow's 'Persist team snapshot' step runs `git add -A; git commit`, so it captured the producer working tree verbatim, including these two out-of-scope files
immutable_git_provenance.note: nothing is deleted from history; this directory only removes the files from the PRODUCER DELIVERABLE tree, where they are both invalid and chain-fatal

why_void.1_independence: The audit of record may only be produced by the workflow's own 'Independent audit' job, which checks out the accepted base (lab/evaluation) and mounts the producer snapshot read-only at /tmp/lex_team (core-lane.yml audit job). A producer-authored file at the gate path is not an independent audit under AGENTS.md rules 5/6 and factory-wide requirements 5/14.
why_void.2_write_scope: results/audit/<lane>/* and reports/audit/<lane>/* are outside the producer write scope (allowed: evaluation/*, tests/evaluation/*, results/evaluation/*, reports/evaluation/*, state/evaluation.json, data/evaluation/*). Executable proof: python -m evaluation.snapshot_audit.write_scope --lane evaluation --repro-from-git c8735dd42be57b61433ef8c86ca6d995e77c2da6 fff0536c518c028a2184d96d972c7d3232819aa9 exits 1 with exactly these two paths BAD; the real control-plane step body, extracted from origin/main and fed the same porcelain through a stubbed git, exits 3 with the identical BAD set.
why_void.3_not_an_auditor_emission: The file contradicts the auditor contract in three independent ways: (a) it lacks the two fields the audit prompt MANDATES (safe_to_integrate boolean, required_fixes array); (b) its producer_commit and audit_base are both 20f780fb0428cc52692ad6342e2e71acd6d3b14c, i.e. main's head at dispatch (GITHUB_SHA), whereas the real audit job records audit_base = lab/evaluation and reads the producer commit from the mounted /tmp/lex_team (for this run: c8735dd4 and fff0536c respectively); (c) the JSON carries duplicate keys (audit_base, integration_scope_note each appear twice).
why_void.4_chain_consequence: Team job 117245339430 step 9 'Enforce lane write scope' concluded failure; the audit job (117247026987) and integrate were skipped; no independent gate for 38982176936 exists anywhere; nothing was promoted; the resilience job dispatched this operational resume.

status_of_the_underlying_deliverable: The two IN-SCOPE files the same producer run produced (results/evaluation/bar_gates/38982176936.json and results/evaluation/snapshot_audit/38982176936.json) are valid re-verification records and are preserved unchanged. Only the self-audit is void.
must_not_be_cited_as: an audit of record, a gate verdict, a promotion, or an acceptance for run 38982176936
gate_path_of_record_for_the_resumed_deli: results/audit/evaluation/CYCLE_38982728075_GATE.json, to be written ONLY by the independent audit job of run 38982728075 (uppercase _GATE.json, from the audit-job checkout, never /tmp/lex_team)
